messages:
Aisha (CSM): Hey team — kicking off onboarding for ArtemisIQ. Goal: get pilot live w/ embeddings + chat in 30 days. Quick sync Thurs 11am PT to align owners and risks. Agenda in the doc: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/artemisiq (PM>please add any execs).
Priya (Kapella): Thanks Aisha — Thurs works for our side. I'll invite our ML lead (Ravi) and Ops (Nora). High-level success criteria: 1) P0: embeddings accuracy >= 88% on our eval set, 2) chat latency p90 < 400ms for short queries, 3) secure VPC integration for prod data by go-live.
Matt (Solutions): @Aisha noted. I'll prep the integration checklist and a quick demo of our sample client. Do we want dedicated capacity or start hosted?
Aisha (CSM): Let's start hosted for rapid iteration; plan Dedicated if throughput hit or privacy concerns. We'll document decision gates in the rollout doc.
Jordan (Eng): For the latency target, what's the expected average query length and QPS during pilot? Need that to size autoscaling.
Priya (Kapella): Average query ~60 tokens, peak QPS ~30, steady ~5. We'll generate a small test corpus.
Tom (Product): Note renewal signal: if the pilot demonstrates <3% regression vs current baseline and infra cost <$X/token, they prioritize contract negotiations. Flagging as a renewal opportunity.
Aisha (CSM): Good call Tom — adding renewal signal as a success metric. Also capturing enablement needs: training for their ML team, runbook for KV caching, and a short SRE handoff.
Matt (Solutions): Draft timeline here — feel free to push edits:
```
Week 1: onboarding call, access + API keys, sample data pull
Week 2: embeddings eval + baseline comparison, dev integration
Week 3: chat integration + latency tuning, observability setup
Week 4: pilot validation, security review, go/no-go and handoff
```
Priya (Kapella): That looks good. Can we shift observability earlier? We want cost + latency dashboards by week2.
Jordan (Eng): Yeah we can spin up dashboards in week2. I'll add tracing and token-level cost charts. Need a list of events to instrument.
Aisha (CSM): Jordan — I'll DM the sample event list. Also tagging risks: 1) data access delays, 2) eval label noise, 3) network egress constraints for their EU users.
Priya (Kapella): Re: EU egress — we may need Private deployment for that scope. How long to validate Private?
Matt (Solutions): Private validation typically 3–4 weeks for the initial setup + VPN/KMS. If EU compliance is mandatory, we should raise that ASAP.
Aisha (CSM): Action items captured: Priya to share contact list + test corpus by Fri, Matt to post integration checklist, Jordan to prep observability templates, Tom to own renewal success metric tracking. I'll send calendar invite and the kickoff doc after this thread.

onboard-bot: Reminder: onboarding kickoff checklist created: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/checklists/1745604321 — please update status fields.
Priya (Kapella): Thanks all. One last ask — can we have a 30-minute enablement session for our Product leads after week2?
Aisha (CSM): Yep — scheduling a 30m enablement after the week2 demo. Added to the agenda. :thumbsup:
Matt (Solutions): I'll prepare a short slide deck on best practices for quantization and batching.
Jordan (Eng): If anyone needs sample logs to test tracing, ping me.
Aisha (CSM): Great — see you on Thurs. If anything blocks before then, post here or DM.
